PROJECT PORTFOLIO OF JORDAN AVERY

Four projects from work and from personal time, newest first.

ORDER TRACKER SERVICE

Work project at Helios Cloud, 2023 to 2024. A service that tracks the state of deployment
requests from submission to completion and exposes the history to product teams.
Tech stack: Go, Kafka, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, deployed on AWS EKS.
Result: handled about 12,000 deployment events per day with a median latency of 40 milliseconds.
Jordan designed the event schema and wrote most of the consumer code.

LOGSLICE CLI

Open source command line tool, started in 2021 and still maintained. It filters and summarizes
large JSON log files from the terminal.
Tech stack: Go, Cobra.
Result: about 300 GitHub stars. Jordan is the sole maintainer.

PENNYWISE BUDGET APP

Personal side project from 2020. A small web app for tracking household spending, built as a
way to learn TypeScript and React properly.
Tech stack: TypeScript, React, FastAPI, SQLite, Docker.
Result: used daily by Jordan and three friends; never deployed publicly.

DEMAND FORECASTING PIPELINE

Work project at Northwind Analytics, 2019 to 2022. A nightly pipeline that forecasts product
demand for retail customers and writes the results to a reporting database.
Tech stack: Python, Apache Airflow, PostgreSQL, AWS S3, AWS Lambda.
Result: forecasts for about 40,000 products, and a 38 percent lower monthly compute bill after
the move to spot instances.
